title: Choose the new visual world for the Ramani homepage
question: The roll assigned Report Day. Keep it, take Kanga, or re-roll.

options.label: Report Day
options.lineage: Kenyan school report books and prize-giving day: cloth covers, coloured card leaves, rubber stamps, teachers' red-pen remarks
options.thesis: Ramani is the report every parent wishes school sent home: what your child is good at, and where it leads.
materials: prize-day photos pasted in with corners
options.viewport: The page opens as a report book on navy cloth: left leaf in amber card carries the headline as the pupil's entry, a handwritten remark gives the 10-minute promise; right leaf is the working grade picker with Take the Test stamped in blue.
options.risk: Report forms are full of ruled boxes; every cell must be a tinted block, never a rule, or it turns into the lined look you rejected.

raised.raise: Four inks on two card stocks, no greys creeping in between.
State is a mark: FREE stamp, red-pen tick for done, PAID seal for unlocked; colour never carries state alone.
One monumental mark per viewport, the big stamped stat or result; captions stay quiet.
Ramani's own photos run large, pasted in like prize-day photographs, never shrunk to thumbnails.
Ranked things (grades, steps, careers) read top to bottom in one column, rank set by position.
Each leaf keeps one open area of bare card around its focal mark.

regions.label: blue leaf: grade picker + stamped CTA

options.label: Kanga Message
options.lineage: East African kanga cloth: bold printed border (pindo), central motif (mji) and a Swahili message panel (jina)
options.thesis: Every section is a kanga: a bold border, one central picture, and a message for the family.
options.viewport: The hero is one full kanga: patterned navy-and-amber border framing the student photo as the central motif, the headline set in the message panel along the bottom with the CTA inside it.
options.risk: The most familiar 'African design' move; pattern weight can tip into costume and cost data on low-end phones.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.thesis: Careers as a strobing data field.
options.viewport: A barcode wall with one sine curve through it.
options.case: Parents and children have no tie to data art; it hides the offer.
options.kept: Total palette commitment, no in-between greys.
options.risk: Cold, and strobing is wrong for children.

options.label: Cutting Bench
options.thesis: Steps as frames on a perforated rail.
options.viewport: A perforated rail across an orange field.
options.case: No relationship to Kenyan school life; a rail of frames is another kind of line.
options.kept: State shown as marks, not hues.

options.label: Plane Portrait
options.thesis: A student built from five flat planes.
options.viewport: A monumental geometric face beside a quiet caption.
options.case: Elegant but Japanese in voice; weak audience identification and the offer gets small.
options.risk: Art-poster distance from a paying parent.

options.label: Title Card Wall
options.thesis: Careers as rows of poster tiles.
options.viewport: Rows of career tiles, the focused one expanding.
options.case: Entertainment framing undercuts a guidance purchase.
options.kept: Real imagery carries the colour, large.
options.risk: Feels like browsing films, not choosing a pathway.

options.label: Glaze Shelf
options.viewport: A row of cups with blue runs.
options.case: No audience tie, no product clarity.
options.kept: Ranked samples read in one gravity-ordered column.

options.label: Ikebana Alcove
options.viewport: One arrangement in an empty alcove.
options.case: No cultural tie, too quiet to convert, and pale where you asked for colour.
options.kept: One open area around each focal mark.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean edtech landing page, executed with full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Split hero, stats bar, steps row, testimonials: the arrangement visitors expect.
canonCard.risk: That is close to the current page and what you said looks too much like the original.
